citations.assessment: Rashi explicitly says he received no explanation and prints HaSeder, whereas Heilprin and the Mekhilta use HaSarad.
The exact lexicon entry attributes the two explanations to a Gaon and gives traps as an example of the implements. Heilprin’s compressed quotation and the clothing term remain distinct.

citations.assessment: The exact narrative places Levi HaSeder and Yishmael behind the three sages. Preserve Heilprin’s name form and order.
The explicit parallel opens the Sabbath section and has Levi HaSarad and the same participants.

holds.reason: The exact Tzemaḥ David identification and passage in Ma’arikh are unconfirmed. The Arukh’s Gaon is the authority for a different explanation and cannot establish this one.
